issues.description: Closure is incomplete. Several exact local candidates have compatible one-row fields but no demonstrated required history; OptionMetrics, CBOE and MPORT1 remain named remote products without a verified route; and the author-prepared ERP file is not supplied. No catalog miss or single-row read establishes availability or date coverage.

The supplied remote DATA step produces MYDIR.SMITHSOJAR_20211102, but PROC DOWNLOAD requests MYDIR.SMITHSOJAR_20211022; the local download instruction and A.SMITHSOJAR_20211022 consumer also use 20211022. This is a preparation-level naming mismatch that the proposed source-hashed working-copy edit can align without changing the table contents or analysis.

The substantive code is stored in one TXT document with remote SAS, local SAS and Stata sections, not separate runnable SAS/DO drivers. Create language-specific working copies that retain supplied order and all branches before execution.

The authors hard-code [redacted-path-7fc00441e0c0] and [redacted-path-6bc4597cabeb] outputs and use separate remote MYDIR and local A libraries. Set consistent working-copy roots, library mappings and result directories; verify the SAS DTA/XLS/XLSX export support before a future run.

The code calls %WINSOR with DSETIN/DSETOUT/BYVAR/TYPE/PCTL parameters, but a matching macro definition or compatible implementation is not supplied or verified. The current official WRDS WINSORIZE page displays a different macro name and parameter signature, so that routine cannot be presumed to satisfy this call; another implementation could be used only after its actual call and percentile behavior are verified.

The main ICC/liquidity branch consumes monthly ERP_PUBLIC_210621 data described as available from the authors, joining by GVKEY and YEAR/MONTH and requiring GLS_AN. This package does not provide the input or establish its consumed schema, units, construction or coverage. A compatible prepared input must match those contracts; original-byte identity is not established as a requirement, and the values must not be independently reconstructed.
The SAS PROC CORR branch reads PPVMALT, but the supplied source constructs PPVMA and has no PPVMALT construction. The intended variable or definition is unresolved; do not silently substitute PPVMA.

evidence.description: The cached code file contains substantial author SAS and Stata program text for the paper.
evidence.quote: **PURPOSE: CREATES DATASET FOR "MEASURING RISK INFORMATION" BY KEVIN SMITH AND ERIC SO;

evidence.description: The opening section uses remote submission to WRDS and requires a user-selected MYDIR location.
Quarterly fundamentals are selected from FUNDQ and SIC is explicitly joined from NAMESQ.
evidence.quote:
from comp.fundq
	where (rdq gt '01JAN1990'd) &
	(rdq ne .) &
	(CUSIP ne '') & 
	(Consol='C' and Indfmt='INDL' and Datafmt='STD' and Popsrc='D')
	order by GVKEY;
run;

proc sql;
	create table ISDCON1  as
	select distinct A.*, B.SIC as DNUM
	from ISDCON A left outer join compa.namesq B
	on (A.GVKEY=B.GVKEY)

evidence.description: The source itself produces MYDIR.ALLVOL from CRSP DSF and the preceding JSOPT table; it is not an absent raw input.
evidence.quote:
proc sort data=JSOPT out=mydir.JSOPT; by permno date; run;
proc sql;
	create table mydir.AllVol as
	select distinct A.Permno, A.CUSIP, A.Date, A.VOL as EDVOL,
	max(B.OPVOL,0) as OPVOL, max(B.CVOL, 0) as CVOL, max(B.PVOL,0) as PVOL,
	max(B.OPDVOL,0) as OPDVOL, max(B.CDVOL, 0) as CDVOL, max(B.PDVOL,0) as PDVOL,
	case when EDVOL gt 0 and OPVOL gt 0 then 100*((OPVOL*100)/EDVOL) else . end as OS
	from crsp.dsf A left outer join mydir.JSOPT B
	on (A.PERMNO=B.PERMNO) 
	& (A.Date=B.Date) 
	& (A.HEXCD in (1,2,3))
	& (A.VOL gt 0)
	& ('01JAN1996'd le A.Date le '31DEC2019'd)
	order by A.PERMNO, A.Date;
quit;

evidence.description: CBOE daily VIX values are joined at the two-weekday-before and two-weekday-after event dates.
CRSP daily returns, market returns and turnover are computed over explicit weekday event windows.
evidence.quote:
create table mydir.SSV1 as
	select distinct A.Permno, A.ActDate,
	std(B.Ret-C.EWRETD) as VMA_257_5,
	std(B.Ret) as VRW_257_5,
	mean(B.VOL/B.SHROUT) as TO_257_5
	from mydir.SSBase A, crsp.dsf B, crsp.dsi C
	where (A.Permno=B.Permno)
	& (B.Date=C.Date)
	& (-257 le intck('WeekDay', A.ActDate, B.DATE) le -5)
	group by A.PERMNO, A.ActDate;

evidence.description: The factor stage joins CRSP daily stock returns to the daily factor file over the stated +/-257 weekday window.
The option-volume stage reads OPPRCD by year and joins it to SECURD and CRSP DSF.
evidence.quote:
proc sql;
	create table C_&yr as
	select distinct A.Permno, A.CUSIP, C.DATE,
	sum(C.Volume) as OPVOL,
	sum(case when C.cp_flag eq 'C' then C.Volume else . end) as CVOL,
	sum(case when C.cp_flag eq 'P' then C.Volume else . end) as PVOL,
	
	sum(C.Volume * (.5*C.best_offer+.5*C.best_bid) ) as OPDVOL,
	sum(case when C.cp_flag eq 'C' then (C.Volume * (.5*C.best_offer+.5*C.best_bid))  else . end) as CDVOL,
	sum(case when C.cp_flag eq 'P' then (C.Volume * (.5*C.best_offer+.5*C.best_bid))  else . end) as PDVOL,
		
	sum(abs((C.Delta*A.PRC)/(.5*C.best_offer+.5*C.best_bid))*C.open_interest)/sum(C.open_interest) as LM,
	sum(C.impl_volatility*C.Volume)/sum(C.Volume) as IV
	from crsp.dsf A, optionm.opprcd&yr C, optionm.securd D
	where (C.SECID=D.SECID) & (A.Cusip=D.Cusip) & (C.date=A.Date)
	& (C.Volume gt 0) & (C.ss_flag eq '0') & (0 lt C.impl_volatility lt 9) & (0 lt C.Vega lt 99)
	group by A.Permno, C.DATE;
